% Pattern: env/conditional/article. \iffalse and a \newif switch hide items.
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\newif\iflong
\longfalse
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}
Kept.
\end{lemma}
\iffalse
\begin{lemma}
Hidden.
\end{lemma}
\fi
\iflong
\begin{lemma}
Only in the long version.
\end{lemma}
\fi
\begin{lemma}
Kept too.
\end{lemma}
\end{document}
